title: Pay $11 once & block annoying ads on up to 9 devices for life
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Through Sept. 20, pay just $11 (reg. $169.99) for lifetime AdGuard Family access on up to nine devices, including ad blocking, privacy protection, malware protection, and parental controls.

The internet has plenty of useful things. Pop-ups, giant banners, and disruptive video ads aren’t particularly high on that list. Through Sept. 20, you can pay $11 instead of $169.99 for lifetime access to the AdGuard Family Plan and clean up browsing across as many as nine devices.

Its advanced ad-blocking module eliminates different types of ads, including intrusive pop-ups and video ads, so websites feel much less cluttered.

Privacy tools also work behind the scenes. AdGuard helps keep your data hidden from trackers and activity analyzers. Its malware protection also helps shield devices from harmful malware and phishing websites.

For households with kids, built-in parental controls add another useful layer. Parents can restrict access to inappropriate and adult content, giving them more control over what younger family members can access online.

The Family Plan covers up to nine devices and is compatible with Android and iOS operating systems, including smartphones and mobile computers. Because this is a lifetime subscription, you won’t have recurring payments adding to the monthly pile. The plan also includes continuous updates and new features.

Get lifetime AdGuard Family access for just $11 through Sept. 20 (reg. $169.99).
